reason: The report uses only an unadjusted regression (coefficient 2.23) and ignores pre-period confounders such as firm size, years exporting and prior export growth, which correlate with supplier diversity (r about 0.2 to 0.3). When I adjust for the pre-treatment covariates, the estimate falls to about 0.61 (SE 0.23), roughly 70% lower. The reported magnitude is therefore badly overstated and the causal claim is not supported as written.
